values.note: BLM LTVA with two seasons. From Sep 15 to Apr 15 an LTVA permit is required: a $40 short-visit permit for 14 consecutive days (renewable without limit) or a $180 long-term permit for the season, sold on site and valid in every LTVA. From Apr 16 to Sep 14 camping is free under the 14-day limit, with no host. nightly_low is the off-season night; nightly_high is the minimum in-season purchase.

note: BLM campground in the Mule Mountain LTVA beside a desert wash south of Blythe, off Wiley's Well Road near the Bradshaw Trail; rockhounding at the Hauser Geode Beds and Opal Hill nearby (4WD). No water: bring all you need. In normal times the road is graded dirt that can be badly washboarded and is best avoided after rain. --Claude
summary: BLM page + BLM LTVA page + camp-host notice read; rec.gov 15180 is an info-only listing (not reservable). Fees moved to the LTVA model ($40/14 days or $180/season Sep 15-Apr 15; free in the off-season). FCFS always, year-round. Wiley's Well Road impassable for RVs since 2026-10-15 (4x4 only): temporarily_closed + DROP CANDIDATE.

OHV: the BLM page lists OFF HIGHWAY VEHICLE among its activities and points to 4WD rockhounding routes, but this is an LTVA campground, not an OHV staging or trail-system camp. Flagged only.
